kind_of_no: seasonal park with a wait list; no price or presence
why: 2026-11-12: Golden Lake Shores (ND HHS 07.17.2025: GOLDEN LAKE SHORES LLC, owners Williams, 30 units, 13652 11th St NE, Hatton) is a seasonal lake park. Its sale listing (Crary Real Estate MLS 24-1125, begun 2024-07-03, sold 2025-04-18, read 2026-11-12) sells 30 water/sewer/electric campsites plus the owner's house as a 'turn-key campground' that 'remains fully reserved with a wait list since it opened in 1999', with lease rate status 100%. That fails long-stay test 2 (nights must be for sale with no waitlist), and nothing shows the new owners selling nights since April 2025. It has no website, booking site or posted rate anywhere. Google Maps has no place under this name (searches return the neighbouring Golden Lake Acres and Golden Lake Tenting). It is on neither RV Life (Algolia park index, 40 km around: only Willowood, Cooperstown, Northwood and Hatton city parks) nor Good Sam (directory cache 2026-10-02, nothing within 40 km). So both the private-park price indicator and the presence indicator fail too.

No Google review screen was possible: Golden Lake Shores has no Google place of its own.
Waterfront gate not run (the lead failed before it). The sale listing's own copy says nightly use is nil, so no seasonal-only site could earn a waterfront value anyway.
